the typed inputs for testing-data-integrity are absent and another technique owns the outcome

triggers: Use when testing end to end flows within quality lifecycle boundaries, especially when does the artifact make the owned decision for testing end to end flows explicit and bounded?.
antiTriggers: the requested outcome does not require testing end to end flows within quality lifecycle boundaries
the typed inputs for testing-end-to-end-flows are absent and another technique owns the outcome

triggers: Use when verify domain invariants across generated inputs, state transitions, serialization, retries, and boundary combinations, especially when is the property stronger than a handful of examples?.
antiTriggers: snapshot-only UI review
behavior with no stable invariant or generative input space

triggers: Use when prove that a skill changes agent behavior under realistic pressure rather than merely sounding persuasive, especially when was a failing baseline observed?.
antiTriggers: a runtime code bug unrelated to agent instructions
a reference document with no behavioral expectation

triggers: Use when route one project from confirmed intent to the next evidence-backed state without loading unrelated skills, especially when can every selected skill name a missing gate artifact?.
antiTriggers: a simple factual question with no product workflow
an existing non-ForgeOS workflow the user did not ask to migrate

triggers: Use when a gate, artifact verification, finding closure, or release decision depends on evidence that may target an old revision, artifact hash, provider version, or environment.
antiTriggers: the evidence is informational and cannot change a decision
no subject identity is available

triggers: Use when assess authority, recency, directness, methodology, conflicts, corroboration, and claim-specific relevance, especially when does the source support the exact claim being made?.
antiTriggers: purely creative writing with no factual claims
a source already authenticated and current by policy

triggers: Use when creating or changing an agent skill whose behavior, routing, discipline, or technique must improve over a measurable baseline rather than merely sound persuasive.
antiTriggers: project-specific instructions that are not reusable
a mechanical rule better enforced entirely in code

triggers: Use when produce a dependency-aware sequence of vertical increments that a fresh agent can execute and independently verify, especially when can an agent with no prior chat execute each task?.
antiTriggers: a one-step reversible edit
work whose requirements are still materially ambiguous

triggers: Use when minimize code, dependencies, layers, and state while fully satisfying contracts, risks, and operability, especially when does every public abstraction have at least one real consumer?.
antiTriggers: a deliberate framework migration requiring broader change
generated code whose size is fixed by schema
